title: Austin's COVID, Housing & Preservation Talks
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   **COVID-19 Response:** Legal issues related to the city's handling of the pandemic were discussed in a private session.
*   **Affordable Housing & Historic Preservation:** Private discussions took place on real estate and legal matters for new affordable housing and protecting historic sites.
*   **Government Transparency:** Legal concerns regarding open government matters were also addressed in a closed-door meeting.
